# attic

> Self-hosted inventory management. Track everything. Lose nothing.

attic is an open-source, self-hosted inventory management application. It lets individuals and teams catalog physical and digital assets — books, games, electronics, tools, and more — with full lifecycle tracking, warranty management, custom attributes, and file attachments. It runs as a single Docker container backed by PostgreSQL and exposes a full REST API.

## Key Features

- **Asset Management**: Create, organize, and track physical and digital assets with full lifecycle management.
- **Smart Import**: Import from Google Books, TMDB (movies/TV), and BoardGameGeek with automatic metadata and cover images.
- **Hierarchical Organization**: Nested categories and locations to mirror real-world setups (room, shelf, box, etc.).
- **Warranty Tracking**: Track warranty providers, dates, and expiration alerts.
- **Custom Attributes**: Unlimited custom fields per category (dates, numbers, text, booleans, dropdowns).
- **File Attachments**: Attach invoices, manuals, photos, and documents to any asset.
- **Full-Text Search**: Search across names, descriptions, tags, and custom attributes.
- **Collections**: Group related assets together (book series, game expansions, etc.).
- **Self-Hosted**: Deploy with Docker; no cloud dependency or subscription required.
- **SSO / OIDC**: Integrate with identity providers like PocketID and Keycloak.
- **REST API**: Full-featured API with interactive Swagger documentation.
- **Plugin System**: Add import sources without writing code.
- **Dark Mode**: Responsive UI with built-in dark theme.
